objective: Investigate reliability risks and performance degradation on kaggle_icu_sepsis_benchmark.csv.

evidence.description: Baseline classification metrics evaluated on kaggle_icu_sepsis_benchmark.csv: sample size 1000.

At the declared 10 percentage-point threshold, raw accuracy exceeds balanced accuracy by 29.08068145290903 points and minority recall by 64.11764705882352 points. Both passing supports the prediction; one passing weakens it; neither passing rejects this threshold-specific prediction on this dataset.

Threshold adjustment from 0.50 to 0.22 shifted recall from 25.9% to 89.4% and accuracy from 90.0% to 67.8%. False negatives changed by -54, false positives changed by +276. Criterion 'recall at_least 0.8' was satisfied.
